node: Housing repair, remodel, rental-maintenance, and affordability-linked building products
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around repair/remodel and affordability-linked housing chokepoints rather than broad new-home construction. The most relevant public-market map includes one reference leader in HVAC replacement distribution and three underfollowed discovery candidates tied to skilled installation labor, fenestration/building-product components, and manufactured-housing inputs. The core bottleneck variables to verify in later layers are contractor access, branch density, product availability during regulatory transitions, repair/remodel revenue mix, and exposure to affordability-driven substitution such as manufactured housing.
